report: Blinded convergence-time shadow review of PR #2036 (issue #2034) at HEAD d05a43f9d, Phases 0-4.3 fanned out to all 6 reviewers, each given the whole diff and resolved ACs with no prior findings. The change makes scripts/verification-flight.py --help self-documenting: adds module-level EXIT_CODE_MEANINGS dict rendered into the top-level parser epilog via _exit_code_epilog(); renders _PROFILE_REQUIRED/_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED required keys plus attach semantics into the claim subparser epilog via _claim_epilog(); both use RawDescriptionHelpFormatter; removes redundant per-code trailing EXIT_* comments (meaning single-sourced in the dict); fixes a stale attach-path comment to name skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md (the prior phase-3-fix-loop.md was the wrong file). Adds 5 tests (TestSelfDocumentingHelp), a CLAUDE.md crib line, and a changeset. All six acceptance criteria verified against the shipped code: AC1 exit-code meanings rendered + completeness test enumerating module EXIT_* constants (set-equality, bool-excluded); AC2 required keys rendered live from the validator's own constants; AC3 attach semantics stated and asserted; AC4 CLAUDE.md crib line names claim --input-file and status --current-checkout-file and routes further questions to --help; AC5 corrected path file confirmed to exist (contains the attach re-anchor rule); AC6 no tool grant added -- lib/capability-profiles.json, .github/workflows/*, lib/test/modules/harness-python-guards.sh all byte-unchanged; diff touches only the script, its test, CLAUDE.md, and a changeset. Tests confirmed to fail against pre-change code (bug-reproduction-first) and pass now. No behavioral change to exit codes/JSON/state. Convention checks clean: single-source-of-truth honored, tests guard the executable --help surface not prose presence, no GNU-only constructs, CLAUDE.md edit is repo-local under the autonomous-run carve-out and reads as instruction-plus-consequence. No Critical/Major/Minor defects. One non-blocking Suggestion (two EXIT_CODE_MEANINGS block comments lean toward restating the render site -- borderline under comment-discipline, useful as single-source pointers, no action required). One out-of-scope observation: status --current-checkout-file carries a copy-pasted --state-dir help string, but this is pre-existing on origin/main and untouched by this diff.

phase3_findings.description: The two added comments on the EXIT_CODE_MEANINGS block ('rendered into --help' and 'Rendered by _exit_code_epilog() below.') lean toward restating where the constant is consumed rather than naming a wrong change prevented; borderline under the comment-discipline rule, useful as single-source pointers. No action required.

diff_profile: help-text/docs-only; touches scripts/verification-flight.py (help epilog renderers + EXIT_CODE_MEANINGS + comment path fix), lib/test/test_verification_flight.py (+5 tests), CLAUDE.md (1 crib line), .changeset/ (new). No behavioral change; no tool grant (AC6).
